name: ester methoxy C Lennard-Jones trial M2 (CAPS, on OPLS-AA 2024)
notes: A trial for the liquid test: methyl acetate came out 2.35 % too light and 0.59 kcal/mol too weakly bound with OPLS-AA 2024's methoxy C 468 (epsilon 0.066 kcal/mol, sigma 3.50 A); methyl methacrylate, which shares 468, was within 0.22 % and 0.04 kcal/mol, so every trial is run on both.
